versions.content: If UdpNmPnEiraCalcEnabled is TRUE and the stored value for a PN is set to requested or back to not requested (see SWS_UdpNm_00347, SWS_UdpNm_00348 and SWS_UdpNm_00351) UdpNm shall inform upper layers by calling PduR_UdpNmRxIndication() for the configured EIRA PDU (i.e changed EIRA information shall be passed to COM).
